assignments.name: Assign_Entitlement_To_Case
assignments.description: Assigns the Entitlement record's Id to the triggering Case record's EntitlementId field in a Before-Save flow, allowing the Entitlement to be associated with the Case before it is saved to the database
assignments.label: Assign Entitlement To Case

decisions.name: Entitlement_Exists
decisions.description: Checks if an Entitlement record was found by evaluating whether the Get_Entitlement_By_Account variable's Id field is not null, routing to 'Found' outcome if Entitlement exists, otherwise ending flow with no changes

rules.name: Found
rules.description: Routes flow to assignment when an Entitlement record is found for the Case's Account
rules.label: Found

decisions.label: Entitlement Exists

recordLookups.description: Retrieves the first Entitlement record associated with the Case's Account to determine if an Entitlement exists for assignment
recordLookups.label: Get Entitlement By Account
recordLookups.name: Get_Entitlement_By_Account
